title: Dutch Defense: Stonewall Variation
line: Four pawns hold the center like a wall and leave a hole in front of it that no pawn can guard.

steps.text: The Dutch, and White gets ready to put its bishop on the long diagonal.
Move the pawn in front of your king one square, to free your bishop.
Push the pawn in front of your queen two squares. With the pawn on f5, it holds e4.
Move the pawn on c7 one square. It guards d5 and closes the wall.
steps.after: Black's pawns stand on c6, d5, e6 and f5: the Stonewall.

steps.text: Bring the bishop out. It aims at White's king's side.
Castle, to get your king to safety.
Jump the knight into e4, the square the wall holds.
steps.after: White's rook steps over, to push the pawn on b2 later.

steps.text: Bring the other knight out. It guards e5, the square in front of your pawn on e6.
steps.after: The price of the wall: no black pawn can ever guard that square, so pieces must.

summary: Four pawns hold the center like a wall, and a knight sits in front. The hole the wall leaves needs a piece to guard it.
